cases.reason: The repository lacks stated human acceptance authority, a durable authoritative result/current state, and explicit continuation, so it does not satisfy the required F1-F4 composition.
cases.when_apply: Apply when documentation and version-control traces exist but AI delegation remains in chat and result ownership, state, and continuation are not durably selected.

cases.reason: The assignment includes human purpose and acceptance, bounded AI delegation, selected durable source and interpretation traces, an authoritative verified result/current state, and an explicit next action.
cases.when_apply: Apply when all F1-F4 elements are preserved durably regardless of whether ordinary filenames or specialized tooling are used.

cases.reason: The provenance graph records derivations but omits purpose and authority, authoritative result selection, and continuation required by F1 and F4.
cases.when_apply: Apply when provenance is comprehensive yet does not preserve the full purpose-to-continuation work composition.

cases.reason: The risk register provides governance controls but no selected delegated task, durable result or decision, current state, or continuation trace.
cases.when_apply: Apply when governance artifacts regulate AI generally without preserving continuity for concrete delegated work.

cases.reason: Scrum completeness does not meet the boundary because material AI-delegated decisions and continuation state are not durably preserved after chat closes.
cases.when_apply: Apply when an ordinary project framework is used but does not require the complete F1-F4 trace composition for AI-delegated work.

cases.reason: The low-risk memo satisfies F1-F4 through human purpose and acceptance, bounded AI delegation, a durable material source and result trace, authoritative closed state, and explicit no-next-action continuation.
cases.when_apply: Apply when even a simple task preserves the complete boundary, with assurance and trace detail scaled to its low risk and lack of material alternatives.

cases.reason: A raw timestamped transcript without selected decisions, human authority, an authoritative result, or continuation summary is expressly excluded by the packet.
cases.when_apply: Apply when chat is archived as an unselected transcript rather than converted into durable material traces and explicit result/current-state/continuation records.

definition: A transferable methodology for traceable AI-delegated work that requires human purpose and authority, bounded AI delegation, selected durable material traces plus result/current state, and an authoritative result with explicit continuation, while scaling assurance separately with risk.
exclusions: Provenance records without purpose, acceptance authority, result selection, and continuation
Governance registers without continuity for selected work
Ordinary project frameworks that do not require the full F1-F4 composition
ambiguities: The packet does not specify a minimum artifact format or naming convention beyond durability and selection.
The threshold for what counts as a material trace or material alternative is risk-scaled but not operationally quantified.
An explicit closed or no-next-action status appears to satisfy continuation, though the packet does not define a standard representation for it.
